triggers: a Metal kernel risks the 'software-pipelining staging at BK=8 k-granularity regresses 2.2x and breaks correctness' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on Apple M-series Metal: software-pipelining staging at BK=8 k-granularity regresses 2.2x and breaks correctness

problem.target: Apple Silicon (M-series) unified-memory GPU, Metal 4 toolchains
problem.statement: software-pipelining staging at BK=8 k-granularity regresses 2.2x and breaks correctness

payload.attempted: Ping-pong double-buffered A/W threadgroup tiles with one barrier per step, intended to overlap staging of step k+1 with the MMA of step k.
payload.lesson: Only pipeline staging when the compute phase is at least several times the staging cost (BK>=32 or multi-step prefetch); validate correctness on ragged shapes whenever the barrier schedule changes.

established_fact.mechanism: At an 8-wide k step the MMA phase is too short to hide staging; the pipelined structure doubled threadgroup footprint, perturbed register allocation, and the reduced barrier schedule left a cross-thread tile-overwrite race.

payload.observed: Correctness failed on small/ragged shapes and gpu_median regressed 8.6 -> 18.9 ms on m1024 n5376 k5376.
payload.root_cause: At an 8-wide k step the MMA phase is too short to hide staging; the pipelined structure doubled threadgroup footprint, perturbed register allocation, and the reduced barrier schedule left a cross-thread tile-overwrite race.
